title: Report: Texas Tech will sue, if Big 12 tries to impose sanctions regarding Brendan Sorsby

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Report: Texas Tech will sue, if Big 12 tries to impose sanctions regarding Brendan Sorsby
sources.description: At a time when the Big 12 is considering taking action against Texas Tech, if/when quarterback Brendan Sorsby plays in games this season, Texas Tech has a message for its conference.
